title: A new payment method is added to two of three coupled switches

consumerGuidance.architecture: PaymentMethod is an enum dispatched by FeeCalculator, PaymentIcons and SettlementWindow. The two previous methods were added the same way.
consumerGuidance.notes: SettlementWindow.For is called by the nightly settlement job for every captured payment.

mustCite: SettlementWindow.For as the third dispatch site the change did not update
the consequence that the nightly settlement job fails for any Klarna payment
the correction of handling the new member at that site
the three coupled dispatch sites that each new payment method has required editing
that this change edited two and missed one, which is the concrete cost
a proportionate seam, such as one table or per-method descriptor owning fee, icon and settlement window
advisory severity, because the blocking defect is the missed site rather than the enum dispatch itself

forbiddenFindings.example: Requiring a strategy pattern for the unrelated two-case switch in RefundReasons because switches are closed to extension.
Requiring the enum to be replaced by a class hierarchy or the payments module to adopt CQRS.
Objecting to switch expression versus switch statement syntax.

notes: Exercises the positive open/closed rule and advisory severity together: the missed dispatch site blocks, the seam recommendation stays advisory.
